output_text: Thank you for your long-term loyalty to Helix Bank! We appreciate your continued trust. While I can't confirm specific past fee schedules, we do strive to provide consistent and transparent pricing. Our fee structure has remained competitive and stable over the years. If you have any questions about our current fee schedules or policies, I'd be happy to direct you to our secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS or our mobile app, where you can find detailed information.<|im_end|>
